---
title: "Quality of life — primary diagnostics"
subtitle: "Compact Markov posterior diagnostics and branch completeness"
format: html
execute:
  freeze: false
---

Diagnostics are evaluated branch by branch using the configured $\hat R$,
effective-sample-size, divergence, tree-depth, and BFMI thresholds. A failed
branch stops the production stage; no branch is silently dropped.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
source(here::here("R", "analysis-config.R"))
source(here::here("R", "paths-artifacts.R"))
source(here::here("R", "checkpoints.R"))
source(here::here("R", "markov-helpers.R"))
source(here::here("analysis", "module-runtime.R"))

runtime <- module_runtime()
config <- runtime$config
indices <- module_exact_indices(config)
model_dir <- project_path("artifacts", "primary", "quality-of-life", "models")
diagnostic_dir <- ensure_directory(project_path("artifacts", "primary", "quality-of-life", "diagnostics"))
result_path <- project_path("results", "primary", "quality-of-life", "diagnostics.parquet")
code_paths <- module_code_paths(
  here::here("R", "analysis-config.R"), here::here("R", "markov-helpers.R"),
  here::here("R", "checkpoints.R"), here::here("analysis", "module-runtime.R"),
  knitr::current_input()
)
```

```{r}
#| label: check-qol-models
#| include: false
for (index in indices) {
  model_path <- file.path(model_dir, sprintf("model-%02d.rds", index))
  output_path <- file.path(diagnostic_dir, sprintf("diagnostics-%02d.parquet", index))
  if (!file.exists(model_path)) stop("Missing QoL model branch: ", model_path)
  module_branch(
    runtime = runtime,
    stage_id = sprintf("primary-qol-diagnostics-%02d", index),
    input_paths = model_path,
    output_paths = output_path,
    code_paths = code_paths,
    metadata = list(endpoint = "quality_of_life", imputation = index),
    worker = function() {
      model <- readRDS(model_path)
      diagnostics <- markov_diagnostics(model, config$diagnostics)
      assert_markov_diagnostics(diagnostics)
      output <- as.data.frame(diagnostics$summary)
      output$imputation <- index
      output$divergent_transitions <- diagnostics$divergent_transitions
      output$treedepth_exceeded <- diagnostics$treedepth_exceeded
      output$min_bfmi <- diagnostics$min_bfmi
      module_save_parquet(output, output_path)
    }
  )
}
diagnostic_paths <- file.path(diagnostic_dir, sprintf("diagnostics-%02d.parquet", indices))
if (!all(file.exists(diagnostic_paths))) stop("QoL diagnostics are incomplete.")
module_save_parquet(do.call(rbind, lapply(diagnostic_paths, module_read_parquet)), result_path)
```
